name: getCloudService
description: Returns a service object for a cloud service such as Amazon S3, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Azure Blob or Azure Service Bus. CF2023+ also supports Google Cloud Storage, Firestore and Pub/Sub.

params.name: vendorCredential
params.description: Credentials for the cloud vendor: either a struct, or the name of a credential alias defined in the ColdFusion Administrator or Application.cfc.

params.name: serviceConfig
params.description: Service configuration: either a struct (with a serviceName key such as S3, SQS, SNS, DYNAMODB, AZURE_BLOB or SERVICE_BUS), or the name of a config alias. CF2023+ For GCP, set vendorName to `GCP` and serviceName to `STORAGE`, `FIRESTORE` or `PUBSUB`.

links.title: Get started with ColdFusion AWS Lambda
links.description: Using getCloudService to list and invoke AWS Lambda functions
